introHtml: Orange emery boards stand out in any setting, making them a smart choice for salons, spas, or event giveaways where visibility matters. The bright color catches attention quickly, so your logo or message gets noticed every time someone reaches for a nail file. Whether you choose the classic Nail File in Sleeve or the plastic sleeve version, these custom orange emery boards offer a practical, everyday branding tool that clients will use repeatedly.
